'''2005 Tennessee State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 16 July 2005 at Outer Limits, 116 Watson Glen, Franklin, Tennessee.<ref name="pcf-5728-80377">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=80377#80377 Tennessee States July 16th....], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 May 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050802104132/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5728 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Royce Russell]] ran it<ref name="pcf-5728-80655">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=80655#80655 Tennessee States July 16th....], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050802104132/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5728 Internet Archive]</ref> and [[Micah Wooten]] announced it.<ref name="pcf-5728-80377" /> Twelve players took part. [[Danny Pack]] won; because he had already won the Alabama State Championship, the runner-up, Micah Wooten, received the bye into Day 2 of the [[2005 World Championship]] at Gen Con.<ref name="pcf-5728-89177">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=89177#89177 Tennessee States July 16th....], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 July 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050802104132/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5728 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Outer Limits, 116 Watson Glen, Franklin, Tennessee<ref name="pcf-5728-80377" />
* '''Dates:''' 16 July 2005, 11:00 am<ref name="pcf-5728-80377" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Royce Russell]]<ref name="pcf-5728-80655" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $15, to be lowered if many players came<ref name="pcf-5728-80655" />
* '''Structure:''' six games; decklists required; clear sleeves not allowed<ref name="pcf-5728-80377" />
* '''Players:''' 12<ref name="pcf-5728-89177" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Danny Pack]]<ref name="pcf-5728-89177" />

== Organization ==

The winner was to receive a bye into Day 2 of the World Championship at Gen Con.<ref name="pcf-5728-80377" /> The tournament was listed on Decipher's DGMA tournament system.<ref name="pcf-5728-80655" /> Russell requested the Players Committee's Ultimate prize package: the opportunity for the winner to design a [[Virtual cards|Virtual Card]], six uncut sheets, two random booster boxes, eight tournament foils, posters and pins.<ref name="pcf-5728-84407">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=84407#84407 Tennessee States July 16th....], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050802104132/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5728 Internet Archive]</ref> The day before the event he asked players to fill out their decklists in advance, bring their player numbers, re-sleeve any decks in clear sleeves and arrive at 10 am.<ref name="pcf-5728-88270">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=88270#88270 Tennessee States July 16th....], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 July 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050802104132/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5728 Internet Archive]</ref> The players split the Ultimate Prize Package together with an extra box of [[Premiere]] and extra posters.<ref name="pcf-5728-89177" />
